# Microsoft.PowerShell.SecretManagement

## About

PowerShell SecretManagement module provides a convenient way for a user to store and retrieve secrets.
See our [Official Documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powershell/module/microsoft.powershell.secretmanagement).

## Usage

Using `Install-PSResource`

## Support

If you have any problems with or questions about this module, please contact us through a [GitHub issue](https://github.com/PowerShell/SecretManagement/issues).

## Feedback

To provide feedback please open an issue [Feedback](https://github.com/PowerShell/SecretManagement/issues).
